name: Beam Over
summary: A nearby-share radar that finds people with its sweep, then beams your file along a glowing arc
about: A glassy share card with a radar. The sweep turns and people nearby pop up as it passes them, each with their device. Tap one and they pulse while everyone else dims, a glowing beam curves out to them, packets stream along it and a ring fills around their face with live megabytes and seconds left. On arrival their avatar pops with a tick, rings and sparks, and the radar carries on. It suits file sharing, photo apps, event check-ins and device pairing screens.
how: Watch the sweep: each person appears with a ripple as it passes them.
Tap or Tab to someone and press Enter: they pulse, the others dim, the file lifts and the sweep slows down.
A beam draws out to them and packets stream along it while their ring fills and the status shows percent, MB and seconds left.
Press Cancel to stop: the beam pulls back and nothing is sent.
When it lands, their avatar pops with a green tick, rings and sparks, then everything resets for the next send.
